title: Bounded decoding vertex value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let each vertex be assigned a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^q$ taking values in $[-1,1]$, and let $\\varepsilon\\in\\mathbb R$, a default symbol in $\\mathrm{Fin}(q)$, and a vertex $v$ be given. The bounded decoding vertex value is the expectation, over a neighbor of $v$, of the bounded decoding edge value for that neighbor.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size q
A table assigning each vertex a function on the q-dimensional sign cube with values in [-1,1]
